prompt: Create a vertical dark-pop horror anime streetwear illustration set in a narrow urban alley covered wall-to-wall with vivid graffiti. Two young punk girls stand full-body in the center, slightly low-angle perspective, facing the viewer with cool, defiant expressions. The scene should feel like Harajuku/Shibuya alternative fashion mixed with cute horror: neon pink, cyan, yellow, black, and white paint splashes, skulls, crosses, cartoon ghosts, bats, stitched monster faces, and spray-painted tags on both walls and the wet pavement. The sky above the alley is bright turquoise blue, framed by tall grimy buildings, fire escapes, pipes, and dense graffiti murals. The girls are close together and similar in height, with pale skin, dark eyes, black hair with bangs, and long side braids or loose strands. Left girl: black oversized hoodie with a large pink creepy-cute cat graphic, black beanie with a small skull/cat patch, ripped black cargo pants with pink straps, dangling chains, star and cross patches, plush skull charms, and chunky black-and-white platform sneakers with hot pink laces. Right girl: white oversized hoodie with a black-and-pink cartoon monster face graphic, pink beret or beanie with a small horror patch, ripped black cargo pants with pink cross patch, chains, charms, and matching chunky platform sneakers. Include exactly 2 main characters. Include many graffiti motifs but make the most visible recurring motifs countable: 5 large cute-horror creature faces on the walls, 3 large pink crosses on clothing or wall art, 4 small skull charms or skull icons on outfits, and 2 large blue/yellow graffiti word shapes on the right wall. Use detailed Japanese anime linework, gritty ink texture, halftone dots, comic-book shading, high contrast, saturated neon colors, paint splatter, distressed fabric, and cinematic low-angle composition. Avoid readable brand logos; any lettering should be stylized graffiti-like gibberish. Theme: dark pop horror; color palette: neon pink, cyan, yellow, black, and white; setting: narrow graffiti-covered urban alley; character style: cute punk anime girls; outfit focus: oversized hoodies, ripped cargo pants, chains, charms, and platform sneakers.
